episodes.title: Odcinek 1
episodes.summary: Still reeling from her husband's death, Detective Katarzyna Zawieja launches an investigation into a murder of a young woman and her missing newborn.

episodes.title: Odcinek 2
episodes.summary: Zawieja investigates the links between the murder and the suspicious debts and business dealings of the victim's husband Kosiński.

episodes.title: Odcinek 3
episodes.summary: As Zawieja and Trepa search for links between the victim and former patients at a psychiatric hospital where she worked, Strzelecki receives a suspicious package.

episodes.title: Odcinek 4
episodes.summary: As the police launch a search for Wróbel, one of the victim's patients, Zawieja visits the prison where he once served time.

episodes.title: Odcinek 5
episodes.summary: The day of Magda's funeral leads Zawieja on a dangerous chase for her killer, but an interrogation with an inmate at Goleniów prison breeds new clues – and increased suspicions.

episodes.title: Odcinek 6
episodes.summary: While Strzelecki takes charge of the case, a dangerous trip to a remote island brings Zawieja closer than ever to the truth.

episodes.title: Odcinek 1
episodes.summary: Zawieja and Trepa continue working at the Szczecin Police Station. They uncover a human trafficking ring also investigated by the Central Bureau.

episodes.title: Odcinek 2
episodes.summary: The new investigation ties to Wojtek's recent case. Zawieja becomes emotionally involved, leading her to make a series of rash decisions.

episodes.title: Odcinek 3
episodes.summary: Suspect interrogations are underway. The lack of evidence frustrates Zawieja as convictions remain elusive.

episodes.title: Odcinek 4
episodes.summary: After a fire at the docks, Zawieja attempts to tie the Lanskis to Oliwier's murder. An unexpected ally helps locate the missing shipping container.

episodes.title: Odcinek 5
episodes.summary: While reeling from a devastating loss, Zawieja vows to locate a trafficking victim's missing daughter.

episodes.title: Odcinek 6
episodes.summary: After surviving a violent shootout, Zawieja faces an impossible choice when her own family is caught in the crosshairs.

episodes.title: Odcinek 1
episodes.summary: Having been demoted to a beat cop, Katarzyna Zawieja investigates a spate of drug overdoses while balancing an increasingly chaotic home life.

episodes.title: Odcinek 2
episodes.summary: After the murder of a high-school teacher reveals a connection to the local drug trade, Zawieja and Trepa investigate possible leads.

episodes.title: Odcinek 3
episodes.summary: As tensions flare between Zawieja and Trepa, the investigation uncovers a possible gang war brewing between Nowak and Molski.

episodes.title: Odcinek 4
episodes.summary: While protesters take to the streets, Zawieja attempts to connect the dots tying Nowak to Molski…but learns a shocking truth about herself instead.

episodes.title: Odcinek 5
episodes.summary: As Nowak's men prepare for their biggest deal yet, Trepa leads the investigation – unaware that Zawieja is missing.

episodes.title: Odcinek 6
episodes.summary: As Zawieja faces off against Molski, an investigation brings corruption on the force to light, and Trepa learns a surprising truth.
